This water-free drying system involves discharging steam through the drain hose and into the sewer system.
If some amount of water remains in the drain hose due to incomplete water drainage, steam cannot be expelled.
This may result in tapping or grinding noises as well as poor drying performance.
For effective drying performance, an uninterrupted flow of steam through the drain hose needs to be ensured, and water must not accumulate inside the hose.
This can be achieved by gently lowering the drain hose, ensuring it does not form a U-shape (U-trap).
Note The water-free drying system uses a small amount of water to prevent accumulation of dust in the internal components, so please leave the faucet open.
General drying system Washer/dryer combos use a small amount of water for drying.
Overloading the unit may result in degraded drying performance.
When drying thick clothes, folded parts may not dry well.
Try this Water-free drying system Make sure the drain hose descends smoothly to the floor without any bends.
The drying capacity is smaller than the washing capacity.
When connecting the drain hose to the drain hole, the hose should lie flat on the ground so that a U-trap does not form.

Your air conditioner displays an error code when its self-diagnostic system detects a problem.

Error code CH04 indicates a drainage problem caused by a malfunctioning drain pump, a blocked or upward-sloping drain hose, or a dirty filter.

Troubleshooting Laundry Accessories, Washers 04/14/2026 Print Email Copy Link Share If the water doesn't seem to reach the selected temperature during a wash, don't worry—your machine is operating normally.
Cold Water Supply If the incoming tap water is colder than average room temperature (around 20–25°C / 68–77°F), the machine naturally requires more time to heat the water.
If your model features a Normal 40°C or Normal 60°C cycle, selecting one of these can help optimize the water temperature.
LG washers are designed to optimize energy efficiency and prevent high electricity bills.
Why the water may not reach the set temperature Common Reasons 1.
Energy Saving System To prevent unusually high energy consumption from prolonged heating, your washer features a built-in timer.
If heating takes too long, the machine will automatically proceed to the next phase of the wash cycle to save energy, even if the exact target temperature hasn't been fully reached.
Helpful Tips 1.
Rest assured, your washer is operating normally.
This is a built-in feature designed to save energy, so you can continue using your machine without any worries.
However, keep in mind that heating the water will take longer, and the machine may proceed to the next phase of the wash cycle before fully reaching your selected temperature.
To speed up the wash cycle, make sure the hot water hose is properly connected to a hot water tap and the valve is fully open.

Troubleshooting Vacuums 03/31/2026 Print Email Copy Link Share Causes and Symptoms There is a foreign object in the vacuum nozzle.
The vacuum nozzle or extension pipe is not attached properly.
The exhaust filter is not attached properly.
The vacuum cleaner operates by drawing in outside air as the motor rotates.
However, if the nozzle, pipe, or filter is not attached properly, gaps may form and cause an air-leaking sound.
Also, if there is dust or foreign objects in the nozzle or filter, it becomes difficult to draw in air, causing the motor to overwork and become louder.
If the nozzle or pipe is blocked by foreign objects, the suction power becomes excessively strong as it draws air through a narrowed passage, resulting in noise.

Close To find your laptop’s MAC address, press the [Windows] + [R] keys on your keyboard, type cmd in the Run window, and press [Enter].

Quick Machine Recovery is a Windows recovery feature that automatically connects to the Microsoft cloud to find and apply a solution when Windows fails to start.
This feature is enabled by default in Windows Home and does not require any additional installation.
To use it, you need an active internet connection (wired or Wi-Fi).
When Is Quick Machine Recovery Used?

You can use Quick Machine Recovery if your PC fails to boot normally and displays any of the following symptoms or messages: The system freezes on a black screen during startup An error message appears stating “Your device ran into a problem and couldn’t be repaired” A message appears stating “Unable to connect to a network” The system does not progress past the Windows logo or remains stuck on the network connection screen Checking Quick Machine Recovery Settings Quick Machine Recovery is turned on by default in Windows Home.
The [Automatically check for solutions] option is set to run once by default.
Go to [Settings] → [System] → [Recovery] → [Quick Machine Recovery] What Happens During Quick Machine Recovery?
If your PC repeatedly fails to start, Windows automatically launches Startup Repair and then enters the Quick Machine Recovery environment.
What to Do If Recovery Fails If Quick Machine Recovery does not resolve the issue, a black screen may appear.

Try this Differences between the induction and highlight burners ➔ Due to a difference in the heating method, the actual heating power of the highlight
burner is weaker than that of the induction burner, with the heating power varying across models.

The induction burner uses a magnetic field to directly heat the container with high efficiency, and the
burner size is large, so the fire power is strong.

However, the highlight heats up the container at a low efficiency by maintaining the top plate at a constant
temperature, and its burner size is also smaller than that of the induction, so its heating power is
weaker.

This means that the highlight and the induction burners have different heating powers due to the different
heating methods and burner sizes.

Tại sao nên thiết lập trang khởi động?
Bạn muốn mở một trang web cụ thể - như Google hoặc mạng nội bộ của công ty bạn - tự động mỗi khi bạn khởi chạy trình duyệt.

Trang khởi động của bạn đã được thay đổi thành một trang web lạ hoặc nhiều quảng cáo, có thể là do phần mềm độc hại hoặc chương trình không mong muốn.

Điều này là bình thường và không cho thấy sự cố.
Xin lưu ý Máy điều hòa không khí không thải ra bụi hoặc khí.
Luồng không khí có thể di chuyển bụi xung quanh, khiến máy lọc không khí của bạn phát hiện ra nó.
Nếu chỉ báo tiếp tục hiển thị 'Kém' sau thời gian dài sử dụng, chúng tôi khuyên bạn nên kiểm tra bộ lọc của mình.
Tại sao đèn báo máy lọc không khí của bạn thay đổi khi máy điều hòa không khí đang bật?
Máy điều hòa không khí của bạn liên tục hút không khí trong nhà, làm mát và giải phóng không khí trở lại phòng.
Điều này tạo ra luồng không khí có thể di chuyển bụi hoặc khí xung quanh, khiến máy lọc không khí của bạn phát hiện ra chúng.
Ngay cả khi chỉ báo chất lượng không khí chuyển sang màu đỏ ('Kém'), cả hai thiết bị đều hoạt động bình thường.
Nếu sự cố vẫn tiếp diễn sau khi vệ sinh bộ lọc, hãy liên hệ với bộ phận Hỗ trợ khách hàng của LG để được hỗ trợ.
Kết quả là, bụi hoặc khí không lưu thông nhiều, vì vậy chỉ báo chất lượng không khí vẫn ở mức 'Tốt' (màu xanh lam).
